reviews.review: garabage game to many op strats that are unfair to new players as myself

This game is ridiculously good. Please make a sequel.

The best game in the Warhammer 40k universe, only competing with Dawn of War 1-2.

This game makes you feel like an Avatar of War, an Angel of Death, a fething one man army. As it should, because you are those things and the game succeeds at that.

The solo campaign is really fun and story is very good at introducing the universe. You don't have to know the lore beforehand, the game will give you enough information to get into the setting. 

But I'm still playing this game 10 years later because of the pvp. The game mods are fun (dreadnought assault is the best thing that ever happened in a shooting game), weapons are variable and they matter, there is no one cookie cutter OP weapon or loadout, and it's very far from a simple shooter pvp game because the weapons are mechanically so different (but the bolter is still an automatic rifle for people who enjoy that classic play style).

I can't get enough of this game and I am begging to developers and publishers, please make a sequel.

EDIT: OH LAWD THE SEQUEL IS COMIN

The main campaign is short but sweet and doesn't overstay it's welcome. Combat, especially in melee is crunchy, visceral and satisfying you really feel the power of a spacemarine. The orks are blast as enemies, especially their leader Grimskull, and it's a shame when they're phased out in favour of a much more generic enemy. The ending leaves it open for a sequel and if one were ever to be developed I'd definitely pick it up.
